services.name: Private Event
services.desc: Nestled among rolling hills in the scenic countryside of Hunterdon County, our farm and vineyard is the perfect place to host your next engagement party, baby shower, quarterly meeting, or birthday celebration. Whatever event you're looking to host, we can accommodate you and your guests with memorable spaces designed for intimate gatherings where you can enjoy our handcrafted wines on the farm where they were grown and made. Voted Hunterdon County’s Best Spot for a Private Party on ‘The Happening List’ 2026. Our outdoor, covered crush pad is available for private events up to 100 guests. services.name: Yoga in the Vineyard - July 24th
services.desc: Immerse yourself in a harmonious blend of nature and relaxation with a Sunset Yoga and Wine Tasting Experience. Breathe in the fresh air and soak in the serene views during an exclusive all-level yoga class set out in the vineyard itself. Afterward, indulge yourself in a seasonal wine tasting on the crush pad, hosted by our knowledgeable staff who will guide you through five seasonally selected wines.
